Dump.description: Downstream-only platform anchor describing the dump capabilities of a device. Consumed by the dump manager to advertise which diagnostic dumps a given device supports.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the dump-capable device. For device-backed dumps this matches the device's MCTP/PLDM target name.

DeviceType.description: Optional device type identifier used to resolve the backing device for the dump.

SupportedDumps.description: The list of dump kinds this device supports (e.g. RoT, SMA, NetIR, GPUDiag). Entries may carry a '=<target>' suffix to bind the dump to a specific sub-device.

Pages.description: Optional list of SMBus page descriptors used to read the dump payload from the device (bus/slave address/register/size per page).

title: Platform Dump Capability Record
description: Downstream entity-manager platform Exposes schema describing the diagnostic dump capabilities advertised for a device.
